instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses Duncan Hines lemon cake mix; if using a different brand please adjust recipe ingredients and cooking times per package instructions.
TO MAKE THE CUPCAKES: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line two 12-cup muffin pans with paper liners and set aside. (Or bake in batches if necessary.)
Place cake mix, eggs, water, and oil in a medium bowl. Using a hand-held mixer, blend on medium for 2 minutes, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (15 oz) box lemon cake mix
½ cup neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Drain and pat peaches dry with paper towels; roughly chop. Add to the bowl with the batter and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (15 oz) can sliced peaches in juice

instructions.primary_message: Fill the muffin liners halfway-full with batter (about ¼-cup each). Place in the preheated oven and bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 19-23 minutes. Remove from oven and allow cupcakes to cool slightly, 5 min. Carefully transfer cupcakes to a wire rack and set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour.
TO DECORATE THE CUPCAKES: Transfer frosting to a piping bag with a star tip. Decorate cupcakes with frosting.
Use a peach ring and gum drop to create an "engagement ring" on each cupcake.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (7 oz) pkg gummy peach rings candy
1 (6.5 oz) pkg gum drop candy

instructions.primary_message: Arrange decorated cupcakes on a platter and enjoy! If planning ahead, refrigerate the cupcakes and let them sit out at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before serving.
